
### Cone for the Notes of the Unit 3 - Sections of Regular Solids and Development of Surfaces in the Subject of ENGINEERING GRAPHICS & DESIGN LAB

* A cone is a three-dimensional object with a circular base and a curved surface that converges at a point.
* The surface of a cone is generated by the rotation of a line segment around a fixed axis.
* The base of a cone is a circle, which is generated by the rotation of a line segment around a fixed axis.
* The volume of a cone is equal to one-third of the product of the base radius and the height.
* The slant height of a cone is equal to the distance between the vertex and the center of the base.
* The lateral surface area of a cone is equal to the product of the circumference of the base and the slant height.
* The total surface area of a cone is equal to the sum of the base area and the lateral surface area.
* The development of a cone is the process of unrolling the cone onto a flat surface.
